meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能用本地 Ollama 模型:列模型、发提示获回复;开启管理功能后,还能拉取、删除、查看模型及查看运行中模型。
howto.when: 当用户说“use ollama”或(若已开启管理功能)要求拉取新模型、查看运行中模型时,Claude 会调用对应工具。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国首都
say.note: 会列出模型并生成回答
会调用拉取工具下载该模型

say.text: 哪些 Ollama 模型正在运行?
say.note: 会列出当前加载的模型

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gets tools to use local Ollama: list models, send prompts; with admin flag, also pull, delete, inspect, list running models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to use local Ollama (e.g., 'use ollama'), pull a new model, or list running models; Claude then calls the matching tool.

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: It will list models and generate an answer.
Calls the pull tool to download that model.

say_en.text: Which Ollama models are currently running?
